name: ai-bias
description: Recognize and correct recurring biases in AI reasoning, evidence use, writing, and revision.

interface.shortDescription: Check AI judgments and repair recurring work biases.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained catalogue and selective checking workflow covering goals, evidence, search, inference, and communication. Explanatory models support flexible tests and repairs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-bias:ai-bias-check to review this work and identify the judgments that need correction.
